content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (5cda1db). forge build --out/-o <path> copies the artifact to a named path -> a standalone ./binary, no /tmp-path / wrapper script. Critic (the #127+#128 audit) verified --out is VERIFICATION-NEUTRAL: the artifact is byte-IDENTICAL with/without --out (cmp equal), the cert/level/fx unchanged (--out only copies), a bad path -> structured ForgeError (no panic), without --out the /tmp path is unchanged. The one residual it found was #130 (a #127 byteview-collision residual, since fixed + critic-clean). The editor now runs standalone: forge build editor.th --entry run --no-sandbox --out ./nano && ./nano. 675 tests.
